_note: Empty by design: no finding in the current runner image warrants a not-affected analysis. The HIGH findings the gate still reports live in third-party binaries already at their latest upstream release (undici in npm 12.2.1's vendored tree; moby/go-archive, golang.org/x/net and docker/docker vendored by buildx 0.38.1; golang.org/x/net vendored by compose 5.6.1) — there is no fixed build to move to and no unreachability argument to make, so they stay visible and clear when upstream republishes. CONTRACT for future entries: each statement is a per-CVE analysis (dead code, unreachable path, or no privilege boundary in this deployment) backed by evidence — never a blanket package ignore, and never a substitute for a fix upstream already shipped. Pin each product PURL to the exact version Trivy detects so a rebuild past the fix stops matching and forces re-review; prune statements whose PURLs no longer match anything. Never use .trivyignore.
